forensic_summary.trigger: Catastrophic Thermal Failure: 'CPU temperature is 75C, system shutdowned' during Capali FOH Chamber Test.
forensic_summary.result: Stabilized Operating Temperature; Prevention of Scrap.

war_stories.label: The Meltdown Mitigation
war_stories.description: Engineered 3-fan side-intake ducting system (P/N 9420-58856-00) to cool embedded Kontron PC in a sealed shell.

war_stories.label: The Origami Spine
war_stories.description: Replaced structural aluminum extrusions with a complex folded steel '4U Rake Back I-Beam' (P/N 9420-58317-00) to meet cost targets.

war_stories.label: The Oven Test
war_stories.description: System reached critical thermal threshold causing immediate shutdown during environmental stress testing.

war_stories.label: Capaldi FOH
war_stories.description: Extensive logging of Ambient vs. CPU/DSP/PSU temperatures to validate thermal solution.

war_stories.label: The Varitronix Deadlock
war_stories.description: Forced to limit display brightness to prevent burnout due to shared component dependency with 'Curtis' project.

war_stories.label: The Berry Creek Incident
war_stories.description: Sustained head injury from falling branch (22 stitches); managed IP conflict crisis from ER while on concussion protocol.

war_stories.label: The 'Lead vs Lead' Mandate
war_stories.description: Enforced 'Solder = LED' vs 'Person = LEED' spelling rule to prevent toxic manufacturing errors.

war_stories.label: CNC First Strategy
war_stories.description: Accepted high unit cost to avoid $50k hard tooling risk during validation.

war_stories.label: The PMS Insert Crisis
war_stories.description: Rejected glue fix for popping inserts; recalculated tolerance to .170 +0.00/-0.012 for mechanical interference fit.

war_stories.label: The 'Blind Mate' Alignment
war_stories.description: Engineered ovalized 'wiggle room' tie plates to prevent connector smash during blind assembly.

war_stories.label: The LED Bleed
war_stories.description: Forced vendor to enlarge spacer holes to seat LED collars deeper, eliminating light bleed.

war_stories.label: The 'Ghost Dimension'
war_stories.description: Discovered the ID model and Mechanical chassis were 1.6 inches apart in length three weeks before tooling release.

war_stories.label: The Yield Flip
war_stories.description: Identified a 50% yield loss on Fader Plates due to 'Over-Constraint'. Reduced 12 screw points to 6, restoring yield to 100%.

war_stories.label: The PSU Heatsink Hack
war_stories.description: Modified PSU mounting brackets to replace rubber feet, using the chassis itself as a heatsink to prevent 75°C shutdown.

isomorphics.label: Thermodynamics
isomorphics.hardware_point: Airflow/Geometry optimization to mitigate heat buildup.
isomorphics.software_point: Thermal throttling and shutdown logic triggers.

part_count_growth.note: Initial thermal matrix configurations. Failed due to high static pressure/low airflow volume.
Expansion to 4U. Addition of 'MacGyver' thermal retrofits: Fan Ducts (LDPE), CPU Shields, 3-fan array.
Full sheet metal package release (26 unique fabrication drawings) including 'Origami Spine' components.
Standardized BOM including service FRUs (Headphone jack access mod) and EMI tape retrofits.

process_density.notes: The 'Origami Spine'. Replaced structural aluminum extrusion to meet <$15k COGS target. Generates Moment of Inertia via folded geometry.
Critical thermal intervention. Forces high-velocity air (12V fan) over Kontron 986LCD-M CPU to prevent 75°C shutdown.
High-visibility cosmetic part. Tooling strategy used family molds to amortize $30k capital cost.

tooling_chain.risk: Yield issues on cosmetic parts (warping/sink marks) required geometric tolerance ECOs.
CNC-first strategy ($561.46 unit cost) used to validate thermal performance before hard tooling commitment.
Removed to meet aggressive cost targets; replaced by folded steel 'Origami' architecture.

supply_chain_nodes.notes: Turnkey assembly. Critical handoff of 26-part sheet metal package via ECO 12263.
Rapid iteration for thermal 'Design of Experiments' (3U vs 4U).
Custom PSU integration requiring 16# cabling and specific mounting feet to clear chassis features.
Source of 986LCD-M Mini-ITX motherboard. High thermal density component causing 75°C crisis.
